profile.summary: If you need 1,000 things done well, I'm your guy.  If you need 1 thing done perfectly I will help you find who you need.

positions.title: Head of Software Engineering
positions.description:
As the Head of Software Engineering at Tubular Network, a startup innovating in hyperlogistics, I lead the design and implementation of key systems for our autonomous robotic shuttle fleet. I architected the orchestration layer that enables shuttle autonomy, optimizing routes and schedules. I also develop the on-shuttle code, which integrates navigation, sensors, safety protocols, and real-time decision-making.

I implement and maintain real-time monitoring and alerting systems to ensure continuous operation and early issue detection. Additionally, I own deployment strategies and CI/CD solutions, automating and optimizing the software delivery pipeline for speed and reliability. I’m hands-on with physical deployments, including wiring components and overseeing construction.

I engage with investors and customers, providing technical insights to support sales and secure commitments. Our engineering team, distributed across multiple cities, collaborates to drive projects forward and execute seamless deployments.

Key responsibilities include:

    - Architecting the orchestration layer and on-shuttle code for autonomous shuttle operations.
    - Managing real-time monitoring and alerting systems for operational health.
    - Owning deployment and CI/CD solutions for fast, reliable software delivery.
    - Leading hands-on physical deployments, from wiring to setup.
    - Mentoring a distributed team and fostering collaboration.
    - Engaging with investors and customers to drive sales and commitments.
    - Killed Wasps in a dark tube (seriously, please ask me about this)

At Tubular Network, I’m proud to help revolutionize hyperlogistics, shaping the future of supply chain automation through innovative software and hardware solution

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Warner Brothers, I played a key role in managing a constellation of microservices for the company’s streaming platform. I was responsible for the implementation and deployment of critical services, with a primary focus on the billing service, through which all sales transactions were processed. This service was vital to our platform’s infrastructure, ensuring reliable handling of high volumes of transactions.

One of my most notable achievements was ensuring that our billing service scaled effectively during major live events, processing up to 20k requests per second. I led the effort to design, implement, and deploy this service, ensuring it could meet the demand while maintaining uptime and accuracy.

Additionally, I collaborated with my team on the monitoring and support of our microservices. While my team owned the monitoring and support efforts, I worked closely with them to ensure the stability and performance of all services, proactively addressing issues to maintain a seamless user experience.

Key responsibilities included:

    - Owning the implementation and deployment of the billing service that processed all sales for the streaming platform.
    - Scaling the system to handle 20k requests per second during peak loads, especially during live events.
    - Collaborating with my team on monitoring and support to ensure the reliability and performance of all microservices.
    - Working with cross-functional teams to ensure services integrated effectively and met business needs.
    - Continuously optimizing services for performance, scalability, and uptime.

And, of course, if you want to hear about our biggest failure (that ended up on the Wall Street Journal), feel free to ask. It was rough, but the technical lessons are super interesting.

At Warner Brothers, I had the opportunity to work in a high-performance environment, honing my skills in building scalable systems and managing critical infrastructure for a major streaming platform.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
As the Founder, Owner, and Head Fitter at Velopez Bike Fit, I built and led a company focused on delivering personalized, precision bike fitting services to cyclists of all levels. I designed and implemented custom fitting processes to optimize comfort, performance, and injury prevention for every rider.

I developed and used cutting-edge tools and technologies to assess riders' biomechanics, posture, and movement. In addition to bike fitting, I also created a bike fitting video analysis tool for professional fitters, which helped streamline the fitting process and improve accuracy. This tool was successfully sold to other bike fitting professionals in the industry.

Beyond fitting, I provided expert guidance on bike adjustments, equipment, and posture corrections, helping cyclists achieve a more comfortable and efficient ride. As the owner, I managed all aspects of the business, including marketing, client acquisition, operations, and finances. I built long-lasting relationships with clients, helping them reach their cycling goals.

Key responsibilities included:

    - Founder and Owner of Velopez Bike Fit, offering customized bike fitting services.
    - Developing a bike fitting video analysis tool for professionals, which I successfully sold to the industry.
    - Using advanced technology to assess riders' biomechanics and customize fits for optimal performance and comfort.
    - Providing expert advice on bike adjustments, equipment, and posture.
    - Managing business operations, including marketing, client acquisition, and finances.
    - Building strong, personalized client relationships and helping cyclists reach their goals.

At Velopez Bike Fit, I’m proud to have helped cyclists optimize their performance and enjoy a more comfortable, efficient ride through expert fitting and innovative tools.
